messages:
sam: Quick proposal — split SIEM exports into two lanes: "redacted" (longer retention, low-sensitivity) and "forensic" (short retention, high-sensitivity). Forensics lane requires timebound access tokens issued by an approval flow. Thoughts?
anja: :eyes: How are you thinking about token lifecycle? timebound tokens + KMS-wrapped keys or ephemeral service accounts?
maria: Prefer ephemeral tokens backed by a short-lived KMS-wrapped envelope key. That keeps CMK usage auditable and avoids long-lived service accounts. Also need RBAC mapping for who can request forensic export.
sam: Agreed. My draft flow:
1) Request via security request UI -> attach justification/ticket (#VULN-912)
2) Approval by oncall + data-owner -> issue timebound token (TTL 4h) scoped to dataset
3) Export agent uses token + envelope key to unwrap temporary SSE-C and streams to analyst.
chris: Question: do we log the unwrapping/unwrap-requests in audit logs? We should. Also retention for forensic exports — propose 30 days and auto-delete, with snapshot hashes stored for legal hold.
sec-bot: Deploy bot notice: Export-service v2.4 deployed to staging with token-timing feature.
anja: For RBAC changes: add two new roles: export:forensic_request and export:forensic_approve. Approvers auto-expire every 90 days. We'll need a migration script to map existing analyst groups.
maria: Also ensure SIEM consumers only get redacted stream by default. For forensic lane, we must require an additional consent flag and a link to the ticket.
sam: Implementation notes — access baton pattern: only one active forensic token per dataset at a time. Prevents concurrent unbounded exports. Also enforce rate limits.
chris: KMS concern — CMK usage spikes during unwrap. We should cache envelope keys per-request and rotate frequently. Ops: monitor CMK usage metrics and set CloudWatch alarm at 60% of current quota.
anja: Can we reuse existing JIT proxy or need a small new service? I think proxy can be extended but requires authn changes. I'll open #INFRA-221 for work.
maria: Action items: anja to draft RBAC changes, sam to write request UI spec, chris to add CMK alarms, I'll draft retention + deletion playbook. Target staging rollout in 2 weeks.
sam: Thanks — please add any blockers here. :lock::calendar:
